# Performance: the rewrite against C

Release builds, measured 2026-11-05T05:12:03Z to 2026-11-05T06:24:18Z on a 10-CPU arm64 MacBookPro18,4 (Apple M1 Max, macOS 27.0.1, Darwin 27.0.0), the legs' samples interleaved; load average 3.66 before and 5.67 after. The rewrite at `3463f8f8d501`. Figures are medians; compare only builds measured on this machine, in one run of this script.


## tests/perf (9 runs each, reference configuration)

## scorecard

A run the scorecard reports errors for is left out of its cell's median and counted as failed in it. A requests run fails when a response is not a 200 or the tool exits with an error; with `--parallel`, Rust's tool exits with a transfer's failure where C's can forget it (DIVERGENCE.md), so a run in which both legs lost transfers can fail on the Rust leg alone.
